reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: Section 9(b) contains a live express warranty package (industry-standard performance p0034, material conformance/freedom from utility-affecting errors p0038, no malicious code p0036, compliance with Laws p0041), covering the preferred position's substantive elements.

Duration is at or above the preferred parameters — the warranties are continuing for the entire Term (one-year Initial Term with auto-renewal, p0016), which exceeds the 90-day/12-month benchmark; the absence of a numeric window is a drafting-form artifact, and the deterministic period check passes.

The disclaimer (p0062) is double-carved ('Except as expressly set forth herein' / 'except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement'), so it reaches only implied warranties and does not swallow the express warranty — nowhere near walk-away 'AS IS'.

Correctly treats the missing repair/re-performance/refund remedy sentence as a sub-element noted in the rationale rather than a material deviation, and reasonably observes that inserting an exclusive remedy would narrow the customer's existing damages/termination rights.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered (paragraphs are unchanged) and no counterparty comment was proposed; retained as internal evidence only.
